name: – Tomas Tobé – § 9/2
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: considers that the establishment of the Centre as a permanent structure by a legal act would represent a qualitative shift from fragmented coordination towards a more integrated, operational and strategic EU-level capacity;
